key_highlights: ASX slides as rising oil prices fuel rate-hike bets; big four banks (CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC) fall on yield concerns
Iron ore in freefall – BHP, RIO, FMG under severe pressure; headline suggests BHP 'mulls suicide' as commodity crumbles
RBA deputy governor signals more inflation action needed, reinforcing hawkish bias and rate-hike expectations
Home buyer sentiment collapses to new milestone; property industry faces 'GFC moment' – severe REIT and construction headwinds
Hormuz Strait escalation drives oil higher, pressuring AUD and global risk appetite; UN warns small businesses hit hardest
Gold miners (Manhattan, Forrestania, Kaiser, Aureka, Larvotto) post strong discoveries – safe-haven bid intact
Santos gas cartel 'breaks' – STO.AX faces structural margin pressure in LNG/gas segment
Qantas (QAN.AX) $35M worker payout and jet incident add operational overhang
Aussies driven into second jobs as mortgage costs bite; living standards collapse masked by public-sector boom

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural decline ('drowning, not waving'); BHP, RIO, FMG under heavy sell-side pressure. Gold miners offset with multiple discovery announcements (Manhattan, Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser, Aureka $8.9M acquisition, Larvotto NSW). Uranium (Infini) also active.
sectors.implications: Diversify away from iron ore exposure; gold and uranium names offer relative strength. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face further downside if ore prices sustain weakness. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NGX.AX, STO.AX gold segment) benefit from safe-haven flows.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall as rising oil fuels rate-hike bets, compressing net interest margin expectations and raising credit-risk concerns. Bond yield worries persist.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face near-term pressure. Rate hikes support NIM but elevate mortgage stress and property credit risk. Monitor RBA commentary closely.

sectors.trend: Hormuz Strait escalation pushes oil higher, benefiting upstream producers. Santos gas cartel 'breaks' – STO.AX LNG margins under structural pressure. El Niño adds weather risk to energy demand.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX) and Santos (STO.AX) see mixed signals: oil upside vs gas margin compression. Geopolitical premium supports energy names short-term.

sectors.trend: Home buyer sentiment collapses to new milestone; property industry faces 'GFC moment'. NZ house price crash returns, signalling regional spillover risk. Construction sector weakened – 'Australia lost ability to build things'.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICPS.AX) and construction (WBC.AX exposure, CSL.AX indirect) face headwinds. Mortgage stress (67) threatens household spending and credit quality.

sectors.trend: Mortgage costs driving second jobs; living standards collapse masked by public-sector employment. Car supply crunch jacks up insurance premiums. Qantas $35M payout and jet incident weigh on QAN.AX.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX, CSL.AX (defensive staples) relatively resilient. QAN.AX faces operational and cost overhang. Consumer discretionary under pressure.

sectors.trend: Limited direct ASX impact. ATO vs Big Tech tax fight (34) signals regulatory tightening on tech. Boston Scientific cyberattack (4) a global cautionary tale. Guardant Health (8) and Insulet (12) are US-listed.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. ATO enforcement may pressure ASX-listed tech (XRO.AX, W1.AX). Cybersecurity spend likely to rise across sectors.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot: rate-hike bets intensify, pressuring banks and property
Iron ore structural decline vs gold safe-haven bid – mining sector bifurcation
Geopolitical escalation (Hormuz, US-Iran) driving oil and risk-off flows
Property/REIT 'GFC moment' – sentiment collapse and credit stress
Living standards squeeze: mortgage costs, second jobs, public-sector dependency
Santos gas cartel break – energy margin restructuring
ATO vs Big Tech – regulatory risk for ASX tech names

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in fixed income; favour floating-rate and short-dated bonds. Overweight banks with strong NIM (CBA.AX).
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (GOLD.AX, NGX.AX) and uranium exposure.
Hedge with energy (WDS.AX) and gold; maintain cash buffer. Monitor oil above $90/bbl trigger.
Avoid property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX); favour office/industrial with strong covenants. Monitor NIM and arrears data.
Reduce STO.AX weight; favour WDS.AX with more diversified LNG portfolio.
Overweight defensive staples (WES.AX, WBC.AX, CSL.AX); underweight discretionary.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven bid and discovery pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Multiple ASX gold discoveries (Manhattan, Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser, Aureka, Larvotto) plus geopolitical risk premium support gold prices.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical overweight energy on Hormuz-driven oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Hormuz escalation and El Niño support oil; WDS.AX offers LNG + oil diversification vs STO.AX gas-only risk.

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt into healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Living standards collapse and property stress favour defensive, dividend-paying names with pricing power.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or exit iron ore exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural decline; BHP 'mulls suicide' headline signals severe sentiment deterioration. FMG.AX and RIO.AX face further downside.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid property REITs and construction names
defensive_moves.rationale: Buyer sentiment at milestone low; 'GFC moment' narrative; NZ crash spillover risk; construction capacity deficit.
RBA hawkish bias and oil-driven inflation pressure AUD; rising yields compress equity valuations.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce QAN.AX exposure pending operational clarity
defensive_moves.rationale: $35M worker payout, jet incident, and industry cost pressures create near-term overhang.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX under pressure from rate-hike bets, iron ore collapse, property sentiment crash, and Hormuz-driven oil volatility. Banks and miners (iron ore) lead declines. Gold and energy provide relative strength. Expect ^AXJO to test lower supports.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if RBA pauses and iron ore stabilises. Gold discovery pipeline and defensive earnings (CSL, WES) support medium-term recovery. Property and construction remain structurally challenged. Living standards squeeze may force policy response.
